name: troubleshooting-mcp-server
description: Prototype MCP server for Windows troubleshooting.

tools.description: Gets camera diagnostics information.

tools.name: get_number_of_cameras
tools.description: Gets the number of cameras connected to the system.

tools.description: Checks if Bluetooth is blocked by Windows policy.

tools.description: Sets whether Bluetooth absolute volume is disabled. Requires the Bluetooth Broker service to be running.

tools.description: Ensures the Bluetooth service is running. Checks the current status and starts the service if it is not running.
